  • Interview Results
  • Selection Process
  • Free AI Interview Tool

  • PwBD candidates: Disability certificate from a competent Medical Board (Annexure-V(A), V(B), V(C) or V(D))
  • Any deviation in the name, father's name or date of birth from the Matriculation certificate found during Document Verification leads to cancellation of candidature and debarment.
  • No daily allowance, conveyance allowance or travelling allowance is paid for Document Verification.
📝 Exam Pattern & Syllabus
  • Cutoff Marks
  • Written Marks
  • Syllabus
  • Who Can Apply Class 10 pass with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and NCVT/SCVT National Trade Certificate in the notified trade
  • Selection Method Merit list based on Matriculation and ITI marks
  • Educational Qualification Passed Class 10 examination or its equivalent (under the 10+2 examination system) with minimum 50% marks in aggregate from a recognized Board (no rounding off will be done)
  • If two candidates have the same marks, the older candidate is preferred. If the dates of birth are also the same, the candidate who passed the Matriculation examination earlier is considered first.
  • The final merit list is prepared division/unit-wise, trade-wise and community-wise, equal to the number of slots, in the descending order of the percentage of marks.

🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION STRATEGY

  • Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Core Syllabus): Arithmetic & Advance Maths के सभी फॉर्मूले, Reasoning के Coding-Decoding/Series/Analogy पैटर्न, और NCERT आधारित Static GK व Science के मुख्य कॉन्सेप्ट्स पूरे करें।
  • Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): पिछले 5 वर्षों के Official Previous Year Questions (PYQs) को टाइमर के साथ हल करें। Calculation Speed बढ़ाने के लिए Tables, Squares, Cubes और Fraction-to-Percentage रोज़ दोहराएं।
  • Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & High-Yield Revision): रोज़ाना 1-2 Full CBT Mock Tests का गहन विश्लेषण (Deep Analysis) करें, कमज़ोर टॉपिक्स पर 50-50 सवाल हल करें और पिछले 1 वर्ष के Current Affairs व Static GK को पक्का करें।

  • SSB Interview: Shortlisted candidates will undergo a five-day SSB assessment.

  • Cutoff Marks
  • Written Marks
  • Syllabus
  • Minimum PCM Marks 60% Aggregate in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics

  • Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Core Syllabus): आधिकारिक सिलेबस (Official Syllabus) को डिकोड करें, Core Domain Subjects और State/General Studies के फाउंडेशन नोट्स तैयार करें और बुनियादी अवधारणाओं को मज़बूत करें।

  • Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & High-Yield Revision): अंतिम 30 दिनों में कोई नई किताब न छूएं—केवल अपने शॉर्ट नोट्स का रिविज़न करें, रोज़ाना 1 Full Mock Test दें और परीक्षा हॉल के टेम्परामेंट व एक्यूरेसी पर फोकस करें।
